blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models still struggle to understand 3D spatial relations across views and update spatial judgments as the observer moves. A common approach fuses 3D reconstruction features into visual tokens, but aligning these features with pretrained semantic representations remains challenging under limited spatial supervision. We propose DK-VLM with Dual-Kernel Attention, which computes attention from both a visual token's input position and its geometric position in the scene. A semantic kernel retains the pretrained model's native attention and positional encoding, while a separate geometric kernel uses estimated 3D points and camera poses to directly modulate attention through point displacements and relative view transformations. Then, a learned gate fuses their outputs. Geometry thus enters attention as position rather than as fused reconstruction features. We further introduce Reference-Frame Composition (RC) supervision to train the model to update its reference frame across successive judgments. It provides stepwise turn and heading targets derived from verified single-step annotations. Among the compared methods, DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest average score across six spatial benchmarks and the highest overall scores on VSI-Bench (74.33) and ReVSI-32 (58.28). RC supervision further improves multi-step spatial reasoning, while the full model preserves general video understanding. Project page: https://sumuru789.github.io/DK-VLM-website/.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型仍然在挣扎着理解三维空间关系跨视角,并随着观察者的移动而更新空间判断. 一种共同的方法将3D重建特征融入视觉符号,但在有限的空间监督下,将这些特征与事先经过训练的语义表现相配合仍然是有挑战性的。 我们提出DK-VLM 具有双核注意, 它计算出注意力 从视觉符号的输入位置 及其在现场的几何位置。 语义内核保留了被预先训练的模型的本土注意力和位置编码,而单独的几何内核则使用估计的3D点和相机来通过点位移和相对取景转换来直接调节注意力. 然后,一个有学识的大门 将他们的输出融合起来。 因此,几何作为位置而非被引信接通的重建特征而引起注意。 我们进一步引入参照-Frame组成(RC)监督,以培训该模型,以更新其历任判决的参照框架。 它提供由已核实的单步说明衍生的相向转动和方向目标. 在比较方法中,DK-VLM-8B在6个空间基准中达到最高平均分,在VSI-Bench(74.33)和ReVSI-32(58.28)上达到最高总分. RC监督进一步改善了多步空间推理,而完整的模型则保留了一般的视频理解. 项目网页:https://sumuru789.github.io/DK-VLM-website/.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Spatial reasoning connects visual understanding to agentic action in the physical world ( Chen et al., 2024 , Su et al., 2026 , Huang et al., 2025 , Zhang et al., 2025a , Driess et al., 2023 , Huang et al., 2023 ) . Tasks like multi-view question answering, long-video understanding, robot manipulation, and embodied planning require more than recognizing visual content ( Yang et al., 2025a , Mangalam et al., 2023 ) .
Specifically, a vision-language model (VLM) must also perceive 3D relations across views and, as the observer moves, keep updating the position and heading on which its subsequent spatial judgments depend ( Chen et al., 2024 , Yang et al., 2025a ) . Despite strong progress in semantic recognition and language reasoning, VLMs remain unreliable at estimating distance, direction, camera motion, and cross-view correspondence, and weaker still on tasks such as route planning that chain several such judgments ( Yang et al., 2025a , Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
空间推理将视觉理解与物理界的代理动作联系起来(Chen等,2024年;Su等,2026年;Huang等,2025年;Zhang等,2025年a;Driess等,2023年;Huang等,2023年). 多视图问答、长视频理解、机器人操纵和体现式规划等任务要求的不仅仅是识别视觉内容(Yang等,2025a;Mangalam等,2023)。
具体地说,一种视觉语言模型(VLM)也必须从各种观点中看到三维关系,随着观察者的移动,不断更新其随后空间判断所依赖的位置和方向(Chen等,2024年;Yang等,2025年a). 尽管在语义识别和语言推理方面取得了很大进展,但VLMs在估计距离、方向、相机运动和交叉视图通信方面仍然不可靠,在诸如路线规划之类的任务上仍然较弱,这些任务连结了几项这样的判断(Yang等人,2025a, 张等,2026b.).

blocks.en: Existing work attempts to enhance spatial reasoning by introducing 3D priors. One common approach fuses features from pretrained 3D reconstruction models with visual representations, incorporating geometry into the content of visual tokens ( Fan et al., 2026 , Li et al., 2026b ) . However, these geometric features are primarily learned for 3D reconstruction, an objective different from semantic understanding in VLMs. Integrating them therefore requires the model to align two different representation spaces while learning spatial relations. With limited spatial supervision, this additional adaptation may limit the effective use of geometry and interfere with the model’s existing semantic representations.
blocks.zh: 现有工作试图通过引入3D前作来增强空间推理. 一种常见的方法从预先训练的有视觉表现的立体重建模型中导出特征,将几何学融入视觉符号的内容(Fan等,2026年;Li等,2026年b.). 然而,这些几何特征主要是为3D重建而学习的,这个目标与VLMs中的语义理解不同. 因此,将它们综合起来,需要该模型在学习空间关系的同时调整两个不同的代表空间。 在有限的空间监督下,这种额外的适应可能限制几何学的有效利用并干扰模型现有的语义表达.

blocks.en: Beyond token content, VLMs already use positional encoding to guide attention. In the Qwen-VL family ( Wang et al., 2024 , Bai et al., 2025b , Bai et al., 2025a ) , multi-modal rotary position embedding (mRoPE) encodes sequence order, time, and 2D image grid coordinates, so that attention between two tokens depends on their relative positions in the input. Position thus offers a second interface for geometry: instead of being fused into token content, geometry can define relations between tokens that directly shape attention ( Miyato et al., 2024 , Li et al., 2025c , Wu et al., 2026 , Xiang et al., 2026 ) . However, input positions describe where a token appears in the input rather than where its content lies in the 3D world. As the camera moves, the same 3D surface appears at different image locations across frames, while neighboring 2D patches can lie at very different depths (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 除了符号内容之外,VLM已经使用位置编码来引导注意力. 在Quen-VL家族(Wang等,2024年;Bai等,2025年b;Bai等,2025年a)中,多模式回转位置嵌入(mROPE)编码序列顺序,时间,和2D图像网格坐标,使两个信使之间的注意力取决于它们在输入中的相对位置. 位置因此为几何提供了第二个接口:不但没有被熔入到符号内容中去,而可以定义直接形成注意力的符号之间的关系(Miyato等,2024;Li等,2025c;Wu等,2026;Xiang等,2026;). 然而,输入位置描述一个符号出现在输入中的地方,而不是其内容位于3D世界. 随着相机的移动,相同的3D表面出现在不同图像位置的相框上,而相邻的2D补丁则可以躺到非常不同的深度(图1.

blocks.en:
Existing geometric attention mechanisms ( Miyato et al., 2024 , Li et al., 2025c , Wu et al., 2026 , Xiang et al., 2026 ) introduce 3D relations directly into attention by applying geometric transformations to queries, keys, or values. However, replacing a pretrained VLM’s native positional encoding with geometric encoding may disrupt the semantic attention patterns learned under the original encoding—patterns that remain useful for spatial understanding.
We therefore bring scene geometry into attention through a separate kernel while retaining the native attention and positional encoding.
blocks.zh:
现有的几何注意机制(Miyato等,2024年;Li等,2025年c;Wu等,2026年;Xiang等,2026年)通过对查询,键或值应用几何转换,直接将三维关系引入了注意. 然而,用几何编码取代预先训练的VLM的原生位置编码,可能会打乱在原始编码-patters下学到的语义注意模式,这些模式对于空间理解仍然有用。
因此,我们通过一个单独的内核将场景几何化为注意,同时保留了本土的注意和位置编码.

blocks.en:
We introduce DK-VLM, which implements this design through Dual-Kernel Attention : attention is computed from both a visual token’s input position and its geometric position in the scene. The semantic kernel keeps the backbone’s native attention and mRoPE unchanged. The geometric kernel uses independent projections and computes relations between visual tokens conditioned on patch-level 3D points and frame-level camera poses, so that displacements between scene points and relative transformations between views directly modulate feature comparison and aggregation. A learned gate fuses the two outputs.
Geometry thus enters attention as position rather than as reconstruction features fused into token content. The geometric inputs are estimated from images, requiring no ground-truth depth or camera poses at inference.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了DK-VLM, 它通过双核注意来实施这个设计:注意力从视觉标志的输入位置及其在现场的几何位置计算出来。 语义内核保持骨干原生关注和mROPE不变. 几何内核使用独立的预测并计算以补丁级3D点和帧级相机所构成的可视符号之间的关系,因此场景点相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相相位相位相位相位相位相相位相位相位相相位相位相相相位相位相相位相相位相位相相位相相位相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 一个有学识的门将这两个产出连接起来。
因此,几何学作为位置而非重建特征进入了关注之中,并融入了象征性内容。 几何输入是从图像中估算出来的,不需要地面真实深度或相机进行推断。

blocks.en: Dual-Kernel Attention gives the model direct access to point displacements and relative view transformations, but successive spatial judgments require more: earlier movements change the position and heading on which later judgments depend, even when the scene layout remains unchanged. Single-step question answering supervises each judgment within a given reference frame and does not explicitly supervise how that frame changes across steps. We therefore introduce Reference-Frame Composition (RC) supervision, which provides stepwise turn and heading targets along landmark routes and view sequences. These targets are derived by connecting verified single-step relations that share landmarks or views within the same scene ( Yang et al., 2025c , Zhang et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: Dual-Kernel Content给予模型直接访问点位移和相对视图转换,但相继的空间判断需要更多:更早的移动会改变后期判断所依赖的位置和取向,即使场景布局保持不变. 单步问题回答在某一参考框架内监督每个判断,而没有明确监督该指示如何在跨步骤中进行修改。 因此,我们实行参照-Frame组成(RC)监督,它提供沿标志性路线和取景顺序分步走和引导目标。 这些目标是通过连接同一场景内具有地标或观点的经核实的单步关系(Yang等,2025c;Zhang等,2025b.)而衍生出来的.

blocks.en: We implement DK-VLM on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025b , Bai et al., 2025a ) . We evaluate it on seven spatial reasoning benchmarks ( Yang et al., 2025a , Zhang et al., 2026b , Yang et al., 2025d , Wang et al., 2025b , Li et al., 2025a , Wang et al., 2025d , Tong et al., 2024 ) and two general video understanding benchmarks ( Fu et al., 2025 , Li et al., 2024 ) . Among the compared methods, DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest six-benchmark average score and the highest overall scores on VSI-Bench (74.33) and ReVSI-32 (58.28), with trainable parameters totaling only 3.86% of its backbone’s parameter count. RC supervision further improves multi-step spatial reasoning, yielding consistent gains on route-planning and viewpoint-related tasks. Ablations show that DK-VLM benefits more from RC supervision than a Qwen baseline fine-tuned on the same instruction data, supporting the complementarity between geometric relation modeling and stepwise spatial supervision. The full model also preserves general video understanding on VideoMME and MVBench.
blocks.zh: 我们在Quen2.5-VL-7B和Quen3-VL-8B上实施DK-VLM(Bai等人,2025年b;Bai等人,2025年a)。 我们用七个空间推理基准(Yang等人,2025a)来评估。 Zhang等,2026b;Yang等,2025d;Wang等,2025b;Li等,2025a;Wang等,2025d;Tong等,2024;和两个一般视频理解基准(Fu等,2025;Li等,2024;). 在比较方法中,DK-VLM-8B在VSI-Bench(74.33)和ReVSI-32(58.28)上实现了最高的6个基准平均分和最高的整体分数,可训练参数总共只占其主干参数数的3.86%. 驻地协调员的监督进一步改善了多步骤的空间推理,在路线规划和观点相关任务上取得了一致的成果。 差异表明,DK-VLM比Quen基线对同一指令数据进行微调更能从RC监督中受益,支持几何关系模型和相继空间监督之间的互补性。 完整的模型还保留了VideoMME和MV Bench上的一般视频理解.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Dual-Kernel Attention , which introduces scene geometry as position through a geometric kernel parallel to a pretrained VLM’s native attention. • Reference-Frame Composition supervision , which supervises reference-frame updates using stepwise targets derived from verified single-step relations. • DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest overall scores among compared methods on VSI-Bench and ReVSI-32 and the highest average in the six-benchmark comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 双核注意,通过一个几何内核将场景几何作为位置,与预先训练的VLM的本土注意平行。 • 参照-Frame组成监督,利用经核实的单步关系产生的分步目标,监督参照框架的更新。 • DK-VLM-8B在VSI-Bench和ReVSI-32上的比较方法中取得了最高的总分,在6个基准比较中达到了最高的平均值.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent work improves spatial reasoning in VLMs through spatial data and reasoning-oriented training. VST and Cambrian-S scale spatial instruction tuning, SpatialLadder adopts a progressive curriculum from perception to reasoning, and SpaceR and SpatialEvo respectively introduce verifiable rewards and deterministic geometric environments ( Yang et al., 2025b , Yang et al., 2025c , Li et al., 2025b , Ouyang et al., 2025 , Li et al., 2026a ) . However, compositional supervision for tracking reference frame changes across observations has received less attention.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作通过空间数据和以推理为导向的培训,改善了VLMs的空间推理. VST和Cambrian-S比例空间教学调整,SpaceLadder采用从认知到推理的渐进式课程,SpaceR和SpaceEvo分别引入可核查的奖励和确定几何环境(Yang等人,2025b;Yang等人,2025c;Li等人,2025b;Oyang等人,2025;Li等人,2026a)。 然而,跟踪各种观测参考框架变化的组成监督受到的关注较少。

blocks.en: One line of work introduces 3D information by encoding coordinates into visual tokens, including Video-3D LLM, LLaVA-3D, and HiSpatial ( Zheng et al., 2024 , Zhu et al., 2024 , Liang et al., 2026 ) . Video-3D LLM adds coordinate embeddings to visual features. Another line introduces features from 3D reconstruction models: VG-LLM adds projected VGGT features to visual tokens, VLM-3R queries reconstruction and camera tokens with cross-attention, and GeoThinker retrieves geometric features according to the current semantic state ( Zheng et al., 2025 , Fan et al., 2026 , Li et al., 2026b ) . These fusion mechanisms let a VLM use geometric representations from reconstruction models, but require aligning features learned for reconstruction with pretrained semantic representations. In contrast, DK-VLM uses estimated 3D points and camera poses to directly modulate attention among visual tokens, rather than incorporating coordinate embeddings or reconstruction features into their content.
blocks.zh: 一行工作通过将坐标编码为可视化符来引入3D信息,包括Video-3D LLM,LLaVA-3D,和Hispatial(郑等,2024年;朱等,2024年;梁等,2026年). 视频-3D LLM在视觉特性中加入了坐标嵌入. 另一行引入了从3D重建模型中的特征:VG-LLM在视觉符号上添加了预测的VGGT特征,VLM-3R查询重建并带有交叉意向的相机符号,而GeoThinker根据当前语义状态检索出几何特征(郑等,2025年;范等,2026年;李等,2026年b.). 这些聚变机制使得VLM使用重建模型中的几何表示,但需要将重建过程中学到的特征与预先训练的语义表示相配合. 相形之下,DK-VLM使用估计的3D点和相机来直接调制可视符号之间的注意力,而不是将坐标嵌入或重建特征纳入其内容.

blocks.en: Positional mechanisms provide another interface for introducing 3D information into Transformers. Geometric Transform Attention (GTA) incorporates group actions induced by camera transformations into attention, while PRoPE, RayRoPE, and ViewRoPE use 3D points, rays, or viewpoints to parameterize positional relations between tokens ( Miyato et al., 2024 , Li et al., 2025c , Wu et al., 2026 , Xiang et al., 2026 ) . These studies show that geometry can directly shape relation computation. How to introduce these mechanisms into a pretrained VLM while retaining its native positional encoding remains less explored.
blocks.zh: 定位机制为将3D信息引入变形器提供了另一个接口. 几何变形注意(GTA)将相机变形所引发的群动纳入到注意力中,而PROPE,RayRoPE,和ViewRoPE则使用3D分,射线,或观点来参数化信使之间的位置关系(Miyato等,2024年;Li等,2025年c;Wu等,2026年;Xiang等,2026年). 这些研究表明几何可以直接塑造关系计算. 如何将这些机制引入经过预先培训的VLM,同时保留其原生位置编码,这方面的探索仍然较少。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Given a sequence of RGB images and a spatial query, DK-VLM uses a geometry frontend to estimate aligned patch-level 3D points and frame-level camera poses from the images ( Wang et al., 2025a , Wang et al., 2026a , Wang et al., 2026b , Lin et al., 2025 , Murai et al., 2025 ) . DK-VLM uses these geometric states rather than latent features specific to a frontend, allowing compatible geometry frontends to be replaced. It models input position and scene geometry through parallel relation kernels. The semantic kernel retains the backbone’s native positional computation, while the geometric kernel is parameterized by the estimated states. Dual-Kernel Attention computes and fuses the outputs of the two kernels (Section 3.1 ). To supervise the composition of geometric relations across observations, Reference-Frame Composition links verified single-step annotations into training chains with stepwise targets (Section 3.2 ). Training jointly optimizes the instruction and pairwise geometric objectives in a single stage (Section 3.3 ). Figure 2 illustrates the dual-kernel architecture.
blocks.zh: 鉴于RGB图像的顺序和空间查询,DK-VLM使用几何前端来估计来自图像的对齐的补丁级3D点和帧级相机(Wang等,2025a), Wang等,2026a;Wang等,2026b;Lin等,2025;Murai等,2025;). DK-VLM使用这些几何态而不是前端特有的潜伏特征,允许相容几何前端被替换. 它通过平行关系内核来模拟输入位置和场景几何. 语义内核保留了骨干原生位置计算,而几何内核则由估计状态参数化. 双核注意计算和引信两个内核的输出(第3.1节)。 为了监督各种观测的几何关系的组成,参照-Frame组成将经过核实的单步说明同有分步目标的训练链联系起来(第3.2节)。 培训在单一阶段共同优化教学和对等几何目标(第3.3节)。 图2说明了双内核结构。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dual-Kernel Attention
blocks.zh: 3.1 双核心注意

blocks.en: To introduce 3D relations while retaining the backbone-native attention computation, we use two relation kernels in parallel. The semantic kernel preserves the semantic, temporal, and two-dimensional image relations learned during pretraining, while the geometric kernel conditions relations among geometry-valid visual tokens on 3D points and camera poses. At each selected Transformer layer, let H ℓ ∈ ℝ L × d H^{\ell}\in\mathbb{R}^{L\times d} be the layer input, with sequence length L L and hidden dimension d d . Both kernels read H ℓ H^{\ell} and produce head-space outputs S ℓ S^{\ell} and G ℓ G^{\ell} . At other layers, attention follows the backbone’s native computation.

blocks.en: Each visual token i i with valid geometry carries a 3D point 𝐱 i ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{x}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} in a common scene coordinate system. It is also associated with the camera-to-world pose C i rel ∈ S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) C_{i}^{\mathrm{rel}}\in SE(3) of its source frame, expressed relative to the first frame. blocks.en: Dual-Kernel Attention conditions token relations on 3D position and relative pose, but multi-step reference-frame reasoning additionally requires composing relative transformations across observations. Standard single-step supervision guides spatial judgments within a given reference frame, but does not explicitly supervise how that frame changes across successive steps. Reference-Frame Composition (RC) instead derives and supervises the reference-frame update at every step. Figure 3 illustrates one such chain and its stepwise targets.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We present DK-VLM, which introduces 3D geometry as position into the attention computation of vision-language models.
Dual-Kernel Attention preserves the native semantic kernel and uses Point GTA and Camera GTA to model relations between scene points and camera motion across views.
Reference-Frame Composition supervision reorganizes existing single-step annotations into training chains with stepwise targets, further improving spatial reasoning over multiple steps.
Among the compared methods, DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest average score across six spatial benchmarks while preserving general video understanding.
Ablations further support the complementarity between geometric relation modeling and stepwise supervision.
blocks.zh:
我们提出DK-VLM,它引入了3D几何作为视觉语言模型的注意力计算位置.
Dual-Kernel Content保留了原生语义内核,并使用Point GTA和相机GTA来模拟场景点和相机跨视运动之间的关系.
参考-Frame 组成监督将现有的单步说明重组为带有分步目标的培训链,进一步改善了多个步骤的空间推理.
在比较方法中,DK-VLM-8B在保持一般视频理解的同时,在六个空间基准中实现了最高平均分.
通缩进一步支持了几何关系模型和相继监督之间的互补性.

blocks.en: A.1 Geometry Preprocessing
blocks.zh: A.1 几何处理

blocks.en: The geometric kernel of DK-VLM uses 3D points and camera poses aligned with visual tokens, without relying on intermediate features from a specific geometry frontend. For each merged visual token, we map the center of its image region to the frontend’s dense 3D point map, accounting for resizing, cropping, and padding in both image preprocessing pipelines. Within each video, we filter out low-confidence points using the 20th percentile of finite depth confidence values as the threshold. We obtain each token’s 3D coordinates by bilinear interpolation over the retained neighboring points, with the interpolation weights renormalized. All visual tokens from the same frame share that frame’s camera pose.
blocks.zh: DK-VLM的几何内核使用3D点和相机外观与可视符号对齐,而无需依赖特定几何前端的中间特征. 对于每个合并的视觉标志,我们将其图像区域中心映射到前端密集的3D点地图上,并计入图像预处理管道中的再大小、裁剪和粘接。 在每段视频中,我们用二十分之一的有限深度置信值来过滤出低自信点。 我们通过双线插入在所保留的相邻点上获得每个指针的3D坐标,插入权重重新正常化。 所有来自同一相框的视觉标志都分享相框的相机外观.

blocks.en: We construct these geometric quantities from the frontend outputs and express them in the coordinate frame of the first camera. Within each video, we center and scale all point coordinates together and apply the same scale factor to camera translations. Point GTA uses the processed scene points as translation anchors and the source frame’s rotation relative to the first frame. Camera GTA uses the relative camera poses. This common representation allows different geometry frontends to use the same geometric attention computation.

blocks.en: Reference-Frame Composition uses planar angular relations extracted from the source annotations. We write ⟨ z ⟩ 360 = z mod 360 ∘ \langle z\rangle_{360}=z\bmod 360^{\circ} for normalization to [ 0,360 ∘ ) [0,360^{\circ}) , with clockwise rotation positive, and use the corresponding circular distance d ∘ d_{\circ} for tolerance checks. We first parse and normalize the source relations, then apply consistency checks specific to each source to obtain the verified single-step annotations used for chain construction. After these checks, scenes are partitioned, and chains are constructed only within one scene and split. During partitioning, scene groups that overlap VSI-Bench are isolated from the RC pool. Finally, an independent validator rereads the source annotations, recomputes every derived target, and verifies scene and split membership together with source provenance. These checks cross-validate source angle annotations and their algebraic consistency; they do not use images, XYZ coordinates, or ground-truth 3D states.

blocks.en: RC produces four target types: VSI angle contains exact turn sequences; VSI action contains the corresponding discrete actions for eligible chains; SPAR delta contains local yaw increments; and SPAR heading contains cumulative headings relative to the initial view. Each target sequence is serialized as a JSON array in the assistant response of a separate training sample. No sample jointly emits two target types. The validator independently reconstructs these arrays and checks their provenance against the source relations before they enter autoregressive SFT.
blocks.zh: 驻地协调员产生四种目标类型: VSI角度包含精确的转动序列;VSI动作包含相应符合条件的链条的离散动作;SPAR三角洲包含局部的yaw增量;而SPAR标题包含与初始视图相适应的累积标题. 每个目标序列在单独的训练样本的助理响应中被序列化为JSON阵列. 没有样本共同释放出两种目标类型. 校验器独立地重建了这些阵列,并在它们进入自旋 SFT 之前对照源关系检查出处.

blocks.en: A.5 Output Projection and Gate Initialization
blocks.zh: A.5 产出预测和大门初始化

blocks.en: At each selected layer, we initialize the shared output projection ϕ g ℓ \phi_{g}^{\ell} by copying the native output projection. The two projections have separate parameters. At positions with valid geometry, both kernel outputs use ϕ g ℓ \phi_{g}^{\ell} ; at other positions, the semantic output uses the native output projection.
blocks.zh: 在每一个选定的层, 我们通过复制本地输出预测来初始化共享输出预测 。 两种预测有不同的参数. 在有效的几何位置上,两个内核输出都使用 \ g l\phi_{g}^{\ell};在其他位置上,语义输出使用本地输出预测.

blocks.en: We initialize g ℓ = 0 g_{\ell}=0 , giving both kernels an initial mixing weight of 0.5. This avoids strongly suppressing the geometric branch at the start of training and keeps the sigmoid gate away from saturation. Each selected layer then learns its own mixing ratio.
blocks.zh: 我们初始化 g l = 0 g_{\ell}=0 ,使两个内核的初始混合重量为 0.5. 这避免了在训练开始时强烈地压制几何分支,并让相克门远离饱和. 每个选定的层然后学习自己的混合比。

blocks.en: A.6 Implementation Details and Parameter Counts
blocks.zh: A.6 执行细节和参数计算

blocks.en: We introduce Dual-Kernel Attention at layers 4, 9, 14, 19, and 24 for DK-VLM-7B and at layers 6, 12, 18, 27, and 33 for DK-VLM-8B, using zero-based indices. The pairwise prediction head reads the pre-fusion geometric features at layer 19 for the 7B model and layer 27 for the 8B model. For both models, the pairwise loss weight increases linearly to 0.1 over the first 5% of training steps.
blocks.zh: 我们对DK-VLM-7B采用分层4,9,14,19和24,对DK-VLM-8B采用分层6,12,18,27和33,使用零基指数. 双向预测头为7B模型读取了19层的预聚几何特征,为8B模型读取了27层. 对两种型号来说,双相减重在前5%的训练步骤中线性地增加到了0.1.

blocks.en: Both models are trained on 32 NVIDIA H200 GPUs for one epoch. Training takes approximately 11 days for the 7B variant and 10 days for the 8B variant.
blocks.zh: 两个型号都接受了32个NVIDIA H200 GPU的培训,一个时代. 7B变种的培训大约需要11天,8B变种需要10天.

blocks.en: Table 8 summarizes the parameter counts of both variants.
blocks.zh: 表8概述了两个变体的参数数。

blocks.en: Table 8: Parameter counts of DK-VLM. Parameter counts are reported in millions (M). Trainable parameters include LoRA, the geometric branch, and the pairwise prediction head. The prediction head is used only during training and removed at inference. All counts exclude the frozen VGGT- Ω \Omega frontend.
blocks.zh: 表8:DK-VLM参数计数。 参数计数以百万(M)计。 可训练参数包括:LORA,几何分支和对等预测头. 预测头只在训练时使用,并在推断时取出. 所有计数都排除了被冻结的 VGGT - 组合到\ Omega 前端 。

blocks.en: A.7 Training Data Composition
blocks.zh: A.7 培训数据构成

blocks.en: We follow the training mixture reported for GeoThinker’s scaled regime ( Li et al., 2026b ) , which contains approximately 1.8M instruction samples. The spatial reasoning data comprise Cambrian-S VSI-590K (590K), SPAR (234K), VLM-3R VSI-Bench instructions (205K), VLM-3R VSTI-Bench instructions (132K), and the MindCube training set (10K). The general video data comprise LLaVA-Hound (64K), PhysGame PhysInstruct (140K), and a general video subset of Cambrian-S-3M (430K).
blocks.zh: GeoThinker(Li等人,2026年b)的分级制度, 空间推理数据包括Cambrian-S VSI-590K(590K),SPAR(234K),VLM-3R VSI-Bench指令(205K),VLM-3R VSTI-Bench指令(132K)和MindCube培训集(10K). 一般视频数据包括LLaVA-Hound(64K),PhysGame PhysInstruct(140K)和Cambrian-S-3M(430K)的普通视频子集.

blocks.en: We construct a pool of approximately 1.6M RC samples from the verified source annotations. For SPAR-RC, we retain one question per view tuple and randomly assign either local yaw increments or cumulative headings as the prediction target. We also retain at most one sample for each image set.
blocks.zh: 我们从经核实的来源说明中建造了一个大约由1.6M RC样本组成的池. 对于SPAR-RC来说,我们每个视图保留一个问题并随机指定局部的yaw增量或累积标题作为预测目标. 我们还保留了每个图像集最多一个样本。

blocks.en: To reduce the concentration of small turns, we group individual turn magnitudes into six 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} bins over the folded angular range from 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} to 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} . Each chain is represented by the multiset of its step-level bins. We use deficit-greedy sampling to favor underrepresented bins, subject to limits of 96 samples per scene and 40 appearances per image.
blocks.zh: 为了降低小转弯的集中度,我们把个体转弯为6个30分30分30分Crc}在折叠角上取出从0分0分Crc}到180分180分80分Crc}。 每个链条都由它的分步平面的多集取出. 我们使用不足的粗采样来偏好代表性不足的垃圾箱,但以每个场景96个样本和每个图像40个外观为限.

blocks.en: For VSI-RC, we retain only samples with video inputs and limit each clip to 40 questions. The retained VSI-RC samples are repeated twice to increase their weight in the training mixture. The final RC training set contains 150K entries and includes only two- and three-step chains.
blocks.zh: 对于VSI-RC,我们只保留带有视频输入的样本,并且将每个片段限制在40个问题. 所保留的VSI-RC样本被重复了两次,以提高其在训练混合物中的重量. 最终的RC培训集包含150K条目,仅包含两步和三步链.

blocks.en: A.8 RC Chain Evaluation
blocks.zh: A.8 驻地协调员链评价

blocks.en: We construct an evaluation set using the same RC procedure, with no overlap with the training samples. It includes four target types: local yaw increments and cumulative headings from SPAR-RC, and turn angles and discrete actions from VSI-RC. We evaluate two-, three-, and four-step chains. RC training uses only two- and three-step chains.
blocks.zh: 我们采用同样的驻地协调员程序构建一套评价,与培训样本不相重叠。 它包括4个目标类型:来自SPAR-RC的当地黄道增量和累积标题,以及来自VSI-RC的转角和离散动作. 我们评估两 三 四步链 驻地协调员培训只使用两步和三步链。

blocks.en: For each chain length, we select up to 80 examples per target type. To cover different angular configurations, SPAR-RC examples are grouped by data source (ScanNet, ScanNet++, or S3D) and the 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} bin containing the largest folded turn magnitude in the chain. VSI-RC angle examples are grouped by the same angular criterion, while action examples are grouped by their complete action sequences. Examples are selected in round-robin order across groups within each target type.
blocks.zh: 每个链长,我们选择每个目标类型最多80个例子. 为了覆盖不同的角配置,SPAR-RC实例按数据源(ScanNet,ScanNet++,或S3D)和包含链条上最大的折叠转子分量的30 QQ 30^{\Circ}取来. VSI-RC角度实例按同角标准分组,而动作实例则按其完整的动作序列分组. 实例按每个目标类型内各组的圆相周期顺序选择。

blocks.en: This gives 320 examples each for two- and three-step chains. Only eight distinct four-step action examples are available, giving 248 examples for four-step chains. The composition of the evaluation set is shown in Table 9 .
blocks.zh: 这为两步和三步链提供了320个实例。 只有8个不同的四步行动实例,为四步链提供了248个实例。 评价组的组成见表9。

blocks.en: Table 9: Composition of the RC evaluation set. Counts denote evaluation examples for each target type and chain length.
blocks.zh: 表9:驻地协调员评价组的组成。 计数表示每个目标类型和链长的评价实例.

blocks.en: Both models are evaluated on the same examples using the same correctness criteria. For numeric angle targets, a step is correct if the shortest circular difference between the predicted and target angles is at most 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} ; discrete actions require exact label matching. We report Progress and Chain Acc. separately for each chain length.
blocks.zh: 这两种模型都使用同样的正确性标准对相同的例子进行评价。 对于数字角度目标,如果预测与目标角度之间最短的圆相差最多为10~~10~circ},一个步骤是正确的;离散动作需要精确的标签匹配. 我们分别报告每个链长的进展和链条。

blocks.en: For a target sequence of length n n , let k k be the number of consecutive correct predictions from the first step. Progress is 100 ​ k / n 100k/n . Once a prediction is incorrect, that step and all subsequent steps receive no credit, even if a later prediction matches its target. For example, a three-step prediction with only its first step correct receives a Progress score of 33.3 % 33.3\% .
blocks.zh: 对于长度为n n 的目标序列,让 k 成为从第一步开始连续正确预测的数量. 进展为100 k/n 100k/n. 一旦一项预测不正确,即使后来的预测与其目标相符,该步骤和随后的所有步骤都得不到任何信用。 例如,只有第一步正确的三步预言获得33.3%的分数。

blocks.en: Chain Acc. assigns a score of 100 100 only when the predicted sequence has the same length as the target and every step is correct, and 0 0 otherwise. Both metrics are averaged over all evaluation examples of the corresponding chain length, pooling the four target types.
blocks.zh: Chain Acc.只在预想的序列与目标长度相同且每一步都正确时,才分配出100-100分的分数,另作0分. 这两个衡量标准均对相应链长的所有评价实例进行平均计算,汇集了四个目标类型。

blocks.en: A.9 Injection Layer Configuration
blocks.zh: A.9 注入层配置

blocks.en: We examine the number and placement of Dual-Kernel Attention layers in DK-VLM-8B. To reduce training cost, all configurations are trained on the same 10% subset of the full training data, with the remaining training settings held constant. All layer indices are zero-based. Pairwise geometric supervision is applied at the penultimate selected injection layer in each configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们审查了DK-VLM-8B中双核注意层的数量和位置。 为了降低培训费用,所有配置都根据全部培训数据中相同的10%子集进行了培训,其余的培训环境保持不变。 所有地层指数都是以零为基础的. 对等几何显示器应用在每个配置的倒数第二个选定的注射层。

blocks.en: Increasing the number of injection layers from three to five improves VSI-Bench performance by 0.77 percentage points, while increasing it from five to seven yields only a further 0.06-point gain (Table 10 ). We therefore use five injection layers by default, achieving performance close to the seven-layer configuration with fewer geometric branches.
blocks.zh: 将注射层的数量从3个增加到5个,使VSI-Bench的性能提高了0.77个百分点,而从5个增加到7个则只能再产生0.06分的收益(表10)。 因此,我们默认使用5个注入层,实现接近七层配置,几何分枝较少的性能.

blocks.en: Table 10: Effect of the number of injection layers on VSI-Bench.
blocks.zh: 表10:注射层数量对VSI-Bench的影响。

blocks.en: With the number of injection layers fixed at five, we compare early, distributed, and late placements. The distributed configuration achieves the highest score among the three, outperforming the early and late configurations by 0.62 and 1.76 percentage points, respectively (Table 11 ). These results support our default choice of distributing geometric injection across model depth.
blocks.zh: 随着注射层数固定为5个,我们比较了早期,分布,以及后期放置. 分布式配置在三人中达到最高分数,早期和后期配置的表现分别比0.62和1.76个百分点(表11. 这些结果支持我们默认选择在模型深度间分配几何注射.

blocks.en: Table 11: Effect of injection layer placement on VSI-Bench. All configurations use five injection layers.
blocks.zh: 表11:注射层布置对VSI-Bench的影响。 所有配置都使用五个注射层.

blocks.en: A.10 Geometry Frontends and Input Frame Counts
blocks.zh: A.10 几何前端和输入框架计数

blocks.en: We examine the sensitivity of DK-VLM-8B to the geometry frontend and the number of input frames on VSI-Bench. Both experiments use the same trained checkpoint, changing only the inference configuration without additional training. We fix the input to 32 frames when comparing frontends and use VGGT- Ω \Omega throughout the frame-count comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了DK-VLM-8B对几何前端的敏感性,以及VSI-Bench上的输入帧数. 两次实验都使用同样的训练有素的检查站,只改变推论的配置而不进行额外的训练. 我们在比较前端时将输入固定为32个帧,并在整个帧数比较过程中使用VGGT-ship =Omega。

blocks.en: DK-VLM uses estimated 3D points and camera poses rather than frontend-specific intermediate features. To test whether this interface supports interchangeable frontends, we replace the default VGGT- Ω \Omega with other geometry frontends at inference. As shown in Table 12 , VGGT- Ω \Omega achieves the highest score of 74.33, while the other frontends score between 72.99 and 73.91, a decrease of 0.42–1.34 percentage points from the default setting. These results show that DK-VLM can use different geometry frontends without retraining while maintaining spatial reasoning performance close to that of the default configuration.
blocks.zh: DK-VLM使用估计的3D点和相机外观而非前端特定中间特征. 为了测试此界面是否支持可互换的前端, 我们推论时将默认的 VGGT - 堆积 \ Omega 替换为其它几何前端 。 如表12所示,VGGT-ship\Omega的得分最高为74.33分,而其他前端的得分最高为72.99分至73.91分,比默认设置降低0.42–1.34分. 这些结果显示,DK-VLM可以在不进行再培训的情况下使用不同的几何前端,同时保持空间推理性能接近默认配置.

blocks.en: Table 12: Geometry frontend comparison on VSI-Bench. All configurations use the same DK-VLM-8B checkpoint and 32 input frames, without retraining.
blocks.zh: 表12:VSI-Bench的几何前端比较. 所有配置都使用相同的DK-VLM-8B检查台和32个输入框,不进行再培训.

blocks.en: With VGGT- Ω \Omega fixed, we increase the number of input frames at inference from 8 to 128. Performance improves with more frames, but the gains diminish: increasing from 8 to 32 frames yields a 9.04-point improvement, whereas increasing from 32 to 128 frames adds only 0.99 points (Table 13 ). The 128-frame setting achieves the highest score of 75.32; our default 32-frame setting approaches this performance with fewer input frames.
blocks.zh: 随着VGGT - 堆积-\Omega的固定,我们推导的输入帧从8个增加到128个. 业绩随着帧数的增加而得到改善,但收益减少:从8个帧增加到32个帧数,提高了9.04分,而从32个帧数增加到128个帧数只增加了0.99分(表13)。 128帧设定达到75.32的最高分;我们默认的32帧设定接近这一性能,输入帧较少.

blocks.en: Table 13: Effect of input frame count on VSI-Bench. All configurations use the same DK-VLM-8B checkpoint and VGGT- Ω \Omega frontend, without additional training.
blocks.zh: 表13:输入框架对VSI-Bench的影响。 所有配置都使用相同的 DK- VLM-8B 检查站和 VGGT- supplate \Omega 前端,没有额外的训练.

blocks.en: A.11 General Video Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: A.11 一般视频评价设置

blocks.en: We use up to 32 frames per video for both VideoMME and MVBench, and evaluate VideoMME without subtitles.
blocks.zh: 我们使用高达32帧的视频 视频MME和MV Bench, 并评估视频MME 没有字幕。

blocks.en: A.12 Comparison of Geometry Injection Strategies
blocks.zh: A.12 几何注射策略比较

blocks.en: We compare different geometry injection strategies based on Qwen3-VL-8B using the same 10% training data subset and optimization settings. All configurations omit the pairwise geometric loss. In addition to Qwen SFT and DK-VLM, we consider three alternatives: adding 3D positional embeddings to visual tokens once at the input; adding 3D positional embeddings to visual tokens at the same five selected decoder layers as DK-VLM, while retaining single-stream attention at each layer; and applying single-kernel GTA at three or five selected decoder layers, directly replacing the positional encoding in the corresponding channels of the native attention. DK-VLM scores 62.78 in this comparison; the score of 63.05 reported in the injection layer experiments (Appendix A.9 ) corresponds to the five-layer configuration with the pairwise geometric loss retained.
blocks.zh: 我们比较基于Qune3-VL-8B的不同几何注射策略,使用相同的10%的训练数据子集和优化设置. 所有配置都省略了对等几何损失 。 除了Quen SFT和DK-VLM之外,我们考虑三种替代方案:在输入时一次在可视化符号上添加3D位置嵌入;在与DK-VLM相同的5个所选解码器层上添加3D位置嵌入到可视化符号上,同时保留每层的单流注意力;在3个或5个所选解码器层上应用单内核GTA,直接取代了本土关注的相应通道中的位置编码. DK-VLM在这个比较中得分为62.78;注射层实验(Appendix A.9)中报告的63.05分对应了五层配置,并保留了对等几何损失.

blocks.en: Table 14: Comparison of geometry injection strategies on VSI-Bench. All configurations omit the pairwise geometric loss.
blocks.zh: 表14:VSI-Bench上几何注射策略比较. 所有配置都省略了对等几何损失 。

blocks.en: Adding 3D positional embeddings at the input and at five layers yields scores of 59.21 and 59.74, respectively, close to the Qwen SFT score of 59.48. In contrast, DK-VLM without the pairwise geometric loss still achieves 62.78, outperforming Qwen SFT and five-layer embedding addition by 3.30 and 3.04 points, respectively (Table 14 ). This shows that, under the current training settings, dual-kernel geometry injection outperforms the two tested additive positional embedding strategies.
blocks.zh: 加入3D位置嵌入入入入和5层分别得分59.21分和59.74分,接近于克文SFT得分59 48. 相形之下,没有对等几何损失的DK-VLM仍能达到62.78分,表现优于Quen SFT和五层嵌入加分,分别为3.30分和3.04分(表14. 这表明,在目前的培训环境中,双内核几何注射超过了两个经过测试的添加剂位置嵌入策略。

blocks.en: Single-kernel GTA scores 45.98 with three injection layers and 39.14 with five, both below the Qwen SFT baseline. With five injection layers, DK-VLM outperforms single-kernel GTA by 23.64 points. In the five-layer single-kernel configuration, the performance drop is accompanied by garbled outputs and poorer instruction following, including responses that do not follow the required answer format. These observations suggest that directly replacing the native positional encoding can impair model performance and output quality in this setting. Overall, these results provide empirical support for our design of retaining the native attention pathway while introducing spatial relations through a separate geometric kernel.
blocks.zh: 单内核GTA分出45.98分,分出3个注入层,39.14分出5个,均低于Quen SFT基准. 以5个注入层,DK-VLM以23.64分的成绩超过单内核GTA. 在5个层次的单内核配置中,性能下降伴随着被绑定的输出和后续更差的指令,包括没有遵循所要求答案格式的响应. 这些观察表明,直接取代原生位置编码会损害这种环境下的模型性能和输出质量. 总的来说,这些成果为我们设计保留本土关注途径,同时通过单独的几何内核引入空间关系提供了经验性支持。
